question: What measures are assigned to the kumuda and lotus elements in this rule?
premises: The kumuda may be two parts.
The lotus is assigned a half part.
An additional half measure is also indicated.
inference: The rule assigns two parts to the kumuda and half-part measures to the lotus and related element.
uncertainties: The scope of cārdhataḥ is slightly ambiguous without the next verse.
plain_english: The kumuda should be two parts, the lotus half a part, and there is also a half measure.
